intro: Across technology, government, healthcare, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure, 36 zero-day articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-09 document a global wave of exploitation spanning Asia, Brazil, China, and Europe. The severity mix comprises 17 critical, 18 high, and one medium finding. Among the most prominent vulnerabilities are CVE-2026-22679 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-34621 at CVSS 8.6, and CVE-2026-3502, CVE-2026-81963, and CVE-2026-85880, each at CVSS 7.8. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos appear as the most frequently tracked threat actors across this coverage.
